```lean
theorem lg_target (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) : a / b + b / c + c / a ≥ 3 := by
  let sum := a / b + b / c + c / a
  have h1 : sum ≥ 3 :=
    (add_le_add_left (mul_self_le_sq (a / b) (b / c) (c / a)) 3).trans
      (le_add_right (add_le_add_left (mul_self_le_sq (a / b) (b / c) (c / a)) 3) 3)
  exact h1
```
